header.name: PatrixWorld Sampler [SMOOTH v0.2.1]
header.description: v0.2.1 SMOOTH — fixes + variant expansion. (1) Fixes v0.1.9 load-time warning by removing phantom minecraft:dirt_path block ID from blocks.json (path shortnames remain aliased in terrain_texture.json). (2) Bumps all 23 variation blocks from 8 → 16 authored variants each using median-filtered tile picking (drops the outer-25% tonal outliers from each Patrix CTM set, then samples 16 evenly from the remaining core — more variety with no popping highlights). (3) Adds sandstone_top + red_sandstone_top variants (16 each, from sandstone/yellow/top + sandstone/red/top CTM). (4) Ports Patrix animated lava — lava_still (8 frames @ 4 ticks) + lava_flow (48 frames @ 1 tick), both with blend_frames enabled, via new textures/flipbook_textures.json. Dark/bright mottled Patrix lava replaces vanilla. (5) Sandstone top now isotropic. Carries v0.2.0 VARIATION + v0.1.9 MYCOPORT + v0.1.8 WATERPORT.
